description: A man in a rust-orange wrapped cloth with a leopard-skin shawl, beaded necklaces and an armband stands on a dirt path, gesturing with an open hand to a group of seated older men in dark wrapped cloth. Behind them are thatched conical-roofed huts with woven wicker walls, smoke and small fires, people carrying bundles and a pot, and a lake at dusk with dugout canoes and banana plants. The painting is dark, realistic oil, fills the frame edge to edge, and has no visible text or frame.
